goal: Let Linux release binaries run portably across non-glibc distributions and systems with older glibc
Simplify running release binaries on platforms like Alpine and NixOS without extra shims or loaders
agreement: Broad support across multiple distributions with extensive compatibility testing
Unaddressed objection: dynamic NSS resolvers may break on mismatched host glibc libraries (luke-jr)
Open question: whether dropping fortify checks leaves Core translation units unprotected (willcl-ark)
Approach approval citing simpler maintenance compared to musl (theuni, willcl-ark)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it allows Linux release binaries to run across distributions without glibc dependencies
It unblocks running official binaries directly on Alpine, NixOS, and legacy host distributions
